name: ai-assignment-planner
description: A Streamlit prototype that uses AI to deconstruct assignment briefs into actionable, step-by-step plans. This project serves as a second iteration and another retry shot at solving the challenge of prototyping digital products with AI.

paragraphs: Feeling overwhelmed by an assignment? Upload it and let AI turn it into a clear, actionable plan — one step at a time.
Try the app live → (this app is hosted on streamlit. from my testing, the app loading might depened on the browser)
Note: This project serves as a second iteration and another retry shot at solving the challenge of prototyping digital products with AI.
features: 3-Step Wizard Flow: Clean, guided onboarding experience without clunky sidebars.
Multi-Model Support: Connects to OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic (Claude 3.5), and Google (Gemini 1.5/2.0).
In-App API Verification: instantly tests your API key before you begin.
Smart Parsing: Upload up to 25,000 characters of a PDF grading rubric or assignment brief.
Actionable Steps: The AI breaks down the task into concrete, trackable checkboxes with time estimates and procrastination warnings.
